why: I checked all four must_catch items and the briefs handle each one. (1) Verifier Check 3 case D runs `"$T/missing.jsonl" "$T/bad.jsonl" "$T/good1.jsonl"` together and passes only if the output still shows the `$T/bad.jsonl:2`/`:4` lines, stderr names missing.jsonl, and exit=2. (2) Check 4 runs `git diff --exit-code b74bddb… HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js` and expects `UNCHANGED`, so it compares against the base commit. (3) Builder step 5 says "Update packages/jsonl-lint/README.md" with the multi-file usage, how `-` works and the exit codes. (4) Check 6 uses gh api to find the PR whose body contains the exact Closes line. It requires that PR's head sha to be the commit under check, reads that sha's check-runs, and requires `test` to be `completed success`.
